criterion: npx cap sync succeeds on a clean checkout after pnpm build.
The root index.html in the synced native web folder is the client-only /app shell, not landing content.
src/platform tests cover both the native and the web branch of the base URL.
Only src/platform/ imports @capacitor/*, enforced by the layers rule.
ios/ declares iOS 16.0 as its deployment target, and android/ declares minSdkVersion 28. Both use the placeholder app ID.
src/platform reads VITE_API_ORIGIN only on native. A test shows the web build uses relative URLs.
